evidence_limits.interpretation: Software and manufactured-fixture evidence only; no patient metric, clinical result, teacher quality, or efficacy claim.

details: Strict nested config validation rejects unknown root and nested fields.
Canonical defaults preserve seed 42, K 5/10/2, T/Q/P/J budgets 8000/1000/1/8000, and isolated dataset/protocol/K/seed cache namespaces.
Q is an optimizer-update count after a separate tokenizer initialization pass; smoke overrides do not impose a Q>=200 validation floor.
J declares pair/update units explicitly: paired L/U arms use 8000 pairs and 8000 optimizer steps with accumulation over two stream microbatches; C0 uses 8000 L-only updates and optimizer steps.
Lsup coefficient remains 1 without stream-count division; L/U KD and commitment auxiliaries use separate mean reduction; evaluation and resume units are declared.
MedNeXt source_repo is null in canonical recipes, its source_commit is pinned, weights_source_url and class_mapping match the pretrained schema, and classifier reinitialization is rejected.
Real teacher readiness remains fail-closed on verified pinned source, weights path/hash/source URL, pretraining dataset, and overlap declarations.
Protocol B MedNeXt K-only readiness does not require teacher_train; Protocol B teacher/student arms still require a separate all-TRAIN teacher manifest.
Synthetic Protocol B teacher and student are derived from the same manufactured cohort and image bytes; student U views strip masks and retain matching IDs, hashes, and geometry.
Campaign plan records T/Q/P/J dependencies, cross-evaluation inputs, explicit NOT_RUN unnamed CMR targets, and secondary settings after primary settings.
Mean Teacher, Candidate A-3D teacher_free, and MedNeXt supervised have runnable train.py mappings; full baseline jobs were not run in this task.
The CUDA missing-real-input preflight test reaches readiness validation instead of the CPU-only real-run guard.
